Why Japan transit advertising for travel brands

The traveller planning their next trip, comparing hotel options, or deciding which airline to book is not sitting at a desk when they make those decisions. They're commuting. And in Japan, that means passing through the world's highest-traffic transit environment - every day, for years.

Japan's rail and station advertising is rated the most positively received media in the country by Japanese consumers - ahead of TV, magazines, and significantly ahead of digital. For a travel or hospitality brand, that trust differential is your opportunity.
